body.statement: If the menu is specialized to \(M=2\), then \(d=1\), \(L(r)=L_{\sqrt{\Sigma(r)}}(\mathcal H)\), and the exact scale identity is \(L_{\sigma}(\mathcal H)=\sigma L_1(\mathcal H/\sigma)\). If \(0<\sigma_1\le\sigma_2\), then \(N(h,\sigma_1^2)\) Blackwell dominates \(N(h,\sigma_2^2)\) by addition of independent Gaussian noise, so \(L_{\sigma_1}(\mathcal H)\le L_{\sigma_2}(\mathcal H)\). Therefore every design minimizing the single contrast variance is regret-optimal; no converse or strict monotonicity is asserted without an additional condition on \(\mathcal H\).
body.justification: The binary reduction is the required sanity check and isolates why three overlapping policies are the first nontrivial case.
body.gap: Binary Gaussian treatment-choice and Neyman allocation results are known; this proposition verifies exact compatibility rather than claiming novelty.
body.consumer: Readers can diagnose whether the new regret criterion changes design only because the action menu creates genuinely multivariate tie geometry.
body.proof_tex:
When \(M=2\), \(d=1\), the Gaussian game in \(\mathrm{def:gaussian\text{-}game}\) observes \(N(h,\Sigma(r))\). By the definition of the binary benchmark this is exactly \(L_{\sqrt{\Sigma(r)}}(\mathcal H)\). If \(Z=h+\sigma\varepsilon\), divide by \(\sigma\) and write \(g=h/\sigma\). Positive homogeneity of regret gives \(\ell_{\mathrm{reg}}(h,j)=\sigma\ell_{\mathrm{reg}}(g,j)\), while \(Z/\sigma\sim N(g,1)\). Taking the same infimum and supremum after this bijective reparameterization yields
\[
L_\sigma(\mathcal H)=\sigma L_1(\mathcal H/\sigma).
\]
If \(0<\sigma_1\le\sigma_2\), generate independently \(E\sim N(0,\sigma_2^2-\sigma_1^2)\). From \(Z_1\sim N(h,\sigma_1^2)\), the randomized rule \(E\mapsto\delta_2(Z_1+E)\) has exactly the risk of any prescribed rule \(\delta_2\) in the \(\sigma_2\)-experiment. Thus the smaller-noise experiment can reproduce every larger-noise risk vector, and
\[
L_{\sigma_1}(\mathcal H)\le L_{\sigma_2}(\mathcal H).
\]
Consequently a design minimizing the sole scalar variance also minimizes binary regret. The simulation argument gives only weak monotonicity, so it makes neither of the disclaimed assertions.
